fields.label: Our FFL Licence Number
fields.description: A web order naming this FFL as the receiving FFL is treated as in-store pickup.

fields.label: Alert Recipients
fields.description: Comma or newline separated; empty sends to all System Managers.

fields.label: Receive Sources
fields.default:
RSR
Distributor
Individual (trade-in)
Manufacturer
Consignment
Other

fields.label: Pending Order overdue after (days)
fields.description: Pending Orders waiting longer than this are marked overdue and listed in the managers' daily digest.

fields.label: Receipt Footer Note
fields.description: Plain text printed under every receipt, one line per line.

fields.label: Shipping Price Includes Sales Tax
fields.description: On: the shipping you enter is what the customer pays, sales tax included; off: sales tax is added on top. Existing orders keep the way they were created.

fields.label: Peace-Officer Exempt Tax Account
fields.description: California stores only: the excise tax account that a sale to a peace officer or law enforcement agency is exempt from. The counter then offers a Peace-Officer Exemption that removes this tax and keeps sales tax.

fields.label: Lock Idle Screen After (minutes)
fields.description: A counter screen locks after this many idle minutes; 0 = never.
A price lowered at the counter needs a Sales Manager or System Manager to approve it with their PIN and a reason.
fields.label: Require Manager Approval for Price Reductions
Gunsmith Labor Item
fields.description: Whether labor is taxed follows this item's own Item Tax Template.

fields.label: Intake Authorization
fields.description: Must be a Per document agreement.

fields.label: Paper 4473 Mode
fields.description: 4473 and NICS are handled on paper outside this system; the counter records a Paper 4473 instead of calling FastBound.

fields.label: Default Transfer Fee
fields.description: Charged per firearm on a transfer ticket.

fields.label: Store Customer ID Numbers
fields.description: Turning this off erases every stored ID number and date of birth.

fields.label: Require Agreements at Sale
fields.description: A counter sale cannot be submitted until the customer has signed the agreements its items need.

fields.label: Used Item Agreement
fields.description: Every Used item needs this signed before a counter sale, unless the Item or its Item Group names its own.

fields.label: Provider
fields.options:
ATF Form Scraper
Data Service
Manual Only
fields.description: Manual Only turns live FFL lookup off.

fields.label: Rate Limit (req/hr)
fields.description: Only used by the ATF Form Scraper provider.

fields.label: Cache TTL (minutes)
fields.description: How long a verification result is reused before it is looked up again.
